findings.description: HS256 signing key falls back to a repo-committed literal when TRUELEND_JWT_SECRET is unset, with no guard or warning for non-dev environments; a forged token for subject 1 would grant ADMIN. Refuted from BLOCK because no deployed surface exists in this range (deploy workflow is an inert placeholder, no docker-compose/.env) and deployment.md documents the value as a dev-only fallback.
findings.fix: Raise at startup when the resolved secret equals the built-in default and env is not dev/test; enforce a minimum key length.

findings.description: One hardcoded password is shared by all five seeded accounts (including ADMIN) and seed_users runs unconditionally in the app lifespan for every TRUELEND_ENV; the same literal is published in README.md. Refuted from BLOCK because seeded synthetic demo accounts with a README password are a specified acceptance criterion (specs/features/F0-platform.md:44) and no instance is deployed.
findings.fix: Skip seeding, or source per-account passwords from TRUELEND_SEED_PASSWORD, whenever env is not dev/test.

findings.description: POST /api/auth/login has no per-IP or per-account rate limiting, backoff or lockout; seeded account emails are documented, enabling unlimited online password guessing and scrypt-driven CPU exhaustion against the p95 SLO.
findings.fix: Add per-IP and per-email rate limiting with exponential backoff plus a temporary lockout counter.

findings.description: FastAPI defaults are kept, so /openapi.json, /docs and /redoc are world-readable and publish the full route table, schemas, role model and error codes to anonymous callers.
findings.fix: Set docs_url/redoc_url/openapi_url to None outside dev/test, or gate them behind require_roles("ADMIN").

findings.description: No Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy or HSTS on any response; the same origin also serves the Swagger UI HTML, so there is no defence-in-depth behind React escaping.
findings.fix: Add a response-header middleware setting nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, a restrictive CSP, and HSTS under TLS.

findings.description: npm audit reports 3 critical and 1 high advisory (18 total) in devDependencies: tinypool prototype-pollution-to-RCE, vitest/@vitest/mocker arbitrary file read and code execution, vite path traversal, server.fs.deny bypass and cross-origin script execution, esbuild dev-server request issue. Dev/CI machines only - no production runtime path - and the fixes are breaking majors, hence WARN not BLOCK.
findings.fix: Schedule the vite/vitest/@vitest/coverage-v8 major upgrade, keep npm audit in CI, and do not expose the dev server or Vitest UI beyond localhost.

findings.description: Policy money fields (min_income, min_amount, max_amount, annual_rate_pct) are bare strings passed to Decimal() in policy_service.py:277; non-numeric input yields an unhandled 500 and NaN/Infinity pass every comparison check, letting a non-finite threshold be written into a policy file and later approved, after which underwriting range checks silently stop behaving as intended.
findings.fix: Constrain the fields with Field(pattern="^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]{2}$"), reject non-finite Decimals, and map parse failures to PolicyFieldValidationError.

findings.description: Raw PAN and Aadhaar are stored in cleartext in the SQLite file with no column encryption, key management or retention path. Verified compensating controls: masked on every read, never returned raw, never logged, synthetic data only.
findings.fix: Encrypt or keyed-hash the pan/aadhaar columns with a key from the environment before any non-synthetic data, restrict DB file permissions, and document retention.

findings.description: verify_password compares scrypt output with `==` (early-exit) rather than a constant-time function, inconsistent with the timing-flat login path built around _DUMMY_HASH.
findings.fix: Use hmac.compare_digest for the hash comparison.

findings.description: PolicyPathTraversalError (and POLICY_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH) map to HTTP 500 but the DomainError handler returns str(exc), embedding the absolute server policy file path in the response envelope.
findings.fix: Return the generic 500 message for 5xx-mapped domain errors and keep details in the redacted log line.

findings.description: The /api/_test/audited-action fixture writes caller-chosen rows into the append-only audit log. F005 fixed the authz gap (ADMIN only) and the route mounts only under TRUELEND_ENV=test, so audit integrity now depends on that env value never being test outside the harness.
findings.fix: Require a non-production build marker as well, or move the fixture out of the production app factory.

findings.description: Stateless 1800 s tokens with no jti or deny-list; logout only clears the in-memory client token, so a stolen token stays valid and role changes or account disables are not honoured until expiry.
findings.fix: Add a token version/jti checked in resolve_principal, or shorten the lifetime with refresh.

findings.description: UploadDocumentRequest.filename has min_length=1 but no maximum, so an unbounded string is persisted and later rendered in the verification UI. No injection results (never logged, never used in a path, React escapes it).
findings.fix: Add max_length=255 and optionally a conservative filename pattern.

findings.description: No CORS middleware today, which is the safe state (the SPA uses relative /api paths via the Vite dev proxy). Recorded so the cross-origin deployment step does not reach for a wildcard origin.
findings.fix: When serving the SPA cross-origin, configure CORS with an explicit origin allowlist and no wildcard with credentials.

findings.description: Test and e2e fixtures embed/import the demo credential. Expected for fixtures; logged only because the same literal is the production seed credential tracked as VULN-002.
findings.fix: After VULN-002 is gated, have fixtures source the password from an env var set by the test harness.

findings.description: assert is used for runtime invariants inside request handlers and services (also api/main.py:92,99,105 and policy_service.py:214,243). None guard authorization, so there is no python -O auth bypass, but -O would strip the pinned-policy_version invariant and let None flow into the decision path.
findings.fix: Replace request-path asserts with explicit domain-error raises, or document that -O is unsupported.
